name: Traced In Ink
source:
A story about a boy named Haruto who wakes up alone in his school one night, but something is off, and a dear classmate whose face and name he can’t seem to remember keeps haunting his mind.

[From [url=https://daipixel.itch.io/traced-in-ink]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫Haruto的男孩的故事，一天晚上他独自在学校醒来，但有些事情不对劲，而他似乎不记得一位亲爱的同学的面孔和名字一直萦绕在他的脑海中。

[来自[url=https://daipixel.itch.io/traced-in-ink]Itch.io[/url]]
